title: Android engineer (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose)
description: A 4-year Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android engineer evaluated against 8 postings: a strong Android match with clear gaps, a semantic mobile role written with zero Android/Kotlin keywords, a slightly senior banking Android role, a marginal Flutter role, and four distractors.
rationale: j2 is the semantic-no-keyword-overlap case: it describes exactly the resume's core competency — native Android development with a declarative UI framework, structured concurrency, DI, and offline persistence — using deliberately generic vocabulary ('the world's most widely used mobile operating system', 'modern declarative UI toolkit', 'structured concurrency') that shares near-zero tokens with the resume's skill names (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Room, Hilt), so TF-IDF has no signal while embeddings should recognize it, hence grade 2. j3 is the same job family with strong stack overlap but a 5+ year bar against the resume's 4 years plus a security-heavy banking domain, hence grade 2 rather than 3. j4 (Flutter) probes the graded boundary: same mobile job family and app-store release overlap, but the core stack (Dart/Flutter) is absent, hence grade 1. Gap target j1 overlaps heavily on Kotlin/Compose/Coroutines/Hilt/Room/Espresso while demanding GraphQL and ExoPlayer (Media3) the resume clearly lacks (high) and preferring Kotlin Multiplatform and Fastlane (low). Distractors span Go backend, embedded firmware, data engineering, and product design — different families with no core-stack overlap.

resume.summary: Android engineer with 4 years of experience shipping consumer apps in Kotlin. Led two production migrations from XML views to Jetpack Compose, and focuses on Coroutines-based concurrency, offline-first architecture with Room, and reliable release pipelines.

jobs.raw_text:
Android Engineer — Wavecrest Media (Remote, US)

Wavecrest builds a podcast and audiobook app with 5M monthly listeners. We are hiring an Android Engineer to own the playback and library experience.

What you will do:
- Build new listening features in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
- Own the playback service built on ExoPlayer (Media3), including offline downloads
- Maintain the Hilt dependency graph and the Room-backed library cache
- Extend our Espresso and JUnit test suites and fix flaky UI tests

Requirements: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, GraphQL, ExoPlayer (Media3). 4+ years of professional Android development, 1+ years shipping Jetpack Compose UI in production. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have: Kotlin Multiplatform, Fastlane release automation, Wear OS.

jobs.raw_text:
Mobile Software Engineer — Fernbrook (Hybrid, Portland OR)

Fernbrook builds a home-energy monitoring product, and our companion app is the primary way customers interact with their hardware. We need an engineer to own it end to end.

You will build and ship the native app for the world's most widely used mobile operating system, move our remaining screens onto a modern declarative UI toolkit, keep asynchronous work safe with structured concurrency, and maintain an offline-first local persistence layer that syncs with our cloud API.

We look for: native development on the market-leading mobile platform, fluency with a modern declarative UI framework, structured concurrency, dependency injection, and disciplined automated testing. 3+ years shipping native consumer apps. Bonus: pairing an app with connected hardware over Bluetooth.

Senior Android Engineer — Crestline Financial (Hybrid, Chicago IL)

Crestline's mobile banking app serves 800k customers, and we are modernizing a mature codebase without breaking trust.

You will migrate legacy Java/XML screens to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, harden biometric login and secure storage flows, improve accessibility across the app, and coordinate our two-week release train.

Requirements: Kotlin, Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, MVVM architecture. 5+ years of professional Android development, including at least one large-scale legacy migration. Bonus: security-sensitive app experience, Compose Multiplatform.

Requirements: Flutter, Dart, state management (Riverpod or Bloc), REST API integration, app store release experience. 2+ years building cross-platform mobile apps. Bonus: native platform-channel work, offline data sync.

Embedded Firmware Engineer — Heliotrope Energy (Onsite, Boulder CO)

Heliotrope builds residential solar inverters and battery controllers.

You will develop firmware in C and C++ on an RTOS, implement power-control loops and safety interlocks, bring up new boards with the hardware team, and maintain our hardware-in-the-loop test rigs.

Requirements: C, C++, RTOS experience (FreeRTOS or Zephyr), low-level debugging with JTAG, CAN or Modbus protocols. 3+ years of embedded firmware development. Bonus: functional-safety standards (IEC 61508), power electronics background.
